subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 3/7] nfsdctl: share the listener nest parser

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch refactors the listener nest parser in nfsdctl to improve code organization and efficiency. The existing parse_listener_get function is split into two functions: parse_sock_nest, which unpacks a NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_ADDR nest, and the original parse_listener_get function, which now only iterates over top-level attributes. This change allows for better handling of mixed attribute replies and prevents counting non-listener attributes as listeners. The patch makes no functional changes to the code's behavior.
